checked_obligation: Verify that the constructed positive-integer pairs are pairwise distinct and hence form an infinite family satisfying the required integrality condition.
reason: From (6) and positivity, t_{k+1}>t_k and y_{k+1}>y_k. Thus n_k=(y_k+1)/2 strictly increases, and m_k=(2y_k+1+t_k)/2 also strictly increases. Hence the pairs are distinct for all k≥0; by n8 and n9 they are positive integral pairs with value 4. The listed quotient and isomorphism rules are irrelevant.
